description: SO(11) BMN Q-cohomology on SU(3)_R highest-weight vectors, columns lam = (7,3,3) ([4,0]) and (5,5,3) ([0,2]) at j = 26, 2J = 0, 1, 2 (one JSON line per sector, fortuity.hwcoh.run_sectors format). Per sector: m = hw multiplicity, r_up = rank of Q from 2J+1, grav = multi-graviton hw classes modulo exact, check = self-check rank = m. Multiplicity of the irrep in the cohomology at 2J = n is h = m_n - r_up(n-1) - r_up(n); non-graviton = h - grav. Result: 2J=1 has h=23, grav=22 in (7,3,3) and h=12, grav=11 in (5,5,3), i.e. one non-graviton class per column; nothing at 2J=0,2.
